What is Pearl?

Pearl is a first-of-its-kind blockchain built on **Useful Proof of Work**. Like other blockchains, Pearl is a decentralized network that records transactions securely and transparently without relying on a central authority.

What makes Pearl different is _how_ the network is secured. Instead of wasting computing power on meaningless calculations, Pearl uses GPU computation that performs **real, economically useful work**, such as AI inference. This means the same GPU effort both secures the blockchain _and_ produces valuable AI services.

What is "Useful Proof of Work"?

Traditional Proof of Work (PoW), used by early blockchains, secures the network by having computers solve cryptographic puzzles. While effective, these computations have no use outside of blockchain security.

Pearl introduces **Useful Proof of Work**, where mining is performed as a _by-product_ of real AI computation. Using Pearl's **2-for-1 Proof of Useful Work model**, GPUs execute AI workloads based on matrix multiplication (MatMul / GEMM), which simultaneously:

- Secure the Pearl blockchain
- Deliver real AI inference services

This converts GPU computation anywhere in the world into **fungible monetary value**, with negligible overhead and minimal additional energy usage.

I am new to crypto and AI — how can I obtain Pearl?

This platform is designed specifically for beginners. You can purchase access to a **cloud-based GPU** using fiat currency.

That GPU runs under Pearl's **2-for-1 Proof of Useful Work model**, meaning it performs real AI workloads while simultaneously mining the Pearl blockchain. As a result, you earn **daily Pearl tokens** while only paying for the underlying GPU usage — no hardware or technical setup required.

Do I need any technical knowledge to use the platform?

**No.** We handle everything for you.

We source GPUs at true market prices, stay fully synchronized with the latest and most optimized Pearl mining software, and continuously collect useful AI workloads to maximize efficiency. You simply purchase access and receive Pearl tokens — we manage the rest.

How does the embedded wallet work?

When you create an account, an **embedded Pearl wallet** is automatically generated for you. This wallet lives inside the platform, so you can view your balance, send and receive tokens, and track transaction history without leaving the app.

Your private keys are secured using **Privy's infrastructure** and can be exported at any time. You always remain in full control of your funds.

Can I mine Pearl on my own?

**Yes.** Pearl's mining kernels are open source, and anyone can rent or operate their own GPU.

However, because we operate at cloud scale, we offer more competitive GPU pricing, deploy the latest optimizations faster, and leverage strategic AI partnerships which helps to partially subsidize the mining of Pearl. This allows us to consistently achieve better performance and returns than most individual miners.

You can choose what is the most profitable way for you to mine.

Why make Pearl mining accessible to everyone?

Over 75% of the world's population does not have access to U.S. stock markets or traditional investment opportunities.

We believe anyone, anywhere should be able to participate in and benefit from a **global AI-driven economy**.

AI consumers are contributing tremendously to the progress of AI (eg, through prompting, labeling and RL) but do not enjoy the **upside of AI** like companies who monetize the AI revolution.

**Pearl** and **Pearl Compute** lets AI consumers hold a non-sovereign asset which is a global index on AI.

Pearl is our way of creating an open, permissionless AI index — powered by useful computation — and making it accessible through simple fiat on-ramps.

Pearl is not a fund, security, or investment product. It is an open, permissionless network that anyone, anywhere can participate in by contributing useful computation — no accreditation, brokerage account, or geographic gatekeeping required.

The all-in-one Pearl platform. Mining, wallets, and more.
